paragraphs.text: Skoa is a legendary goblin embermage from an unknown plane, possibly Dominaria.

Skoa is a characrter that debut in Modern Horizons 3 . As Embermages are common in Jamuraa , and Skoa is mechanically casting Fireblast , which also depicts a goblin and references being cast by an embermage, it is possible Skoa is from Dominaria. Skoa wears red cloth clothing, a cape, and wields a wooden staff.
